en: There are many POKéMON locked\naway in the pen…
The pen door is unlocked.\nThe POKéMON appear to have fled.
Did you come here knowing it's\nTEAM ROCKET's WAREHOUSE?
What do you think you're doing?!
TEAM ROCKET broke up?\nWhat planet are you from?
Oh, now your POKéMON look strong.\nYou're willing to sell them?\pOh?\nYou wanted to battle?
Oh, but…\nToo much!
We can give you a great price.\nSell us your POKéMON!
I got word about you from the\nothers.\pBut there's no way a kid like you'd\nknow our BOSS GIOVANNI!
Don't…you…dare…laugh…
Don't mess in the doings of adults,\nyou jumped-up pip-squeak!
I don't know or care if what I'm\ndoing is right or wrong…\pI just put my faith in GIOVANNI\nand do as I am told.
I…\nI'm shattered…
You're doing things according to\nyour beliefs and morals.\pI understand now…

I've made it so you can come back
in through there.\pWhy don't you go get rested and
refreshed for what lies ahead?\pThe ADMIN after me outranks me
thoroughly as a TRAINER.\pYou'd better steel yourself for one
harsh challenge.

That's quite enough of you 
playing the hero, kid.\pSpreading lies about how TEAM
ROCKET has disbanded…\pIt's such an obvious attempt to
cause confusion in our ranks.\pFortunately, we're not so ignorant
to fall for the lies of a child!\pAnd now, I'll show you how scary
an angry adult can be!

Urgh…
You were too strong…\p…
Th-that's GIOVANNI's BADGE!\pSo it's true?
TEAM ROCKET really has disbanded?
We will abandon this WAREHOUSE…\pBut don't think this is over.\nI won't let this be the end.\pI will find GIOVANNI.\nAnd I will resurrect TEAM ROCKET!\lI will…\pUntil then, farewell!
A report with graphs and text is on\nthe PC monitor.\p“The Influence of Magnetic Waves\non POKéMON Evolution”…\p… … … … … …\pIt's too difficult to understand…

I almost managed to sell the
SAPPHIRE for huge money…\pThen, you just had to come along
and blow the whole deal apart!\pFufu… Fufufufu…
There's no forgiveness for you!
Gah! Darn!\nDarn! Darn!
If I can't sell it, it's worthless!\nGo ahead, take it!
What do you want now?\nGo on, get lost, leave me be.

What, you again?\pYou… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,
are you?\pNo, that can't be right!
GIOVANNI's kid has red hair.\pYou don't have any reasons for
bugging me. Leave me alone!
